Free roadmaps for connected work

Mightora Roadmaps helps you plan activities across workstreams and quarters, connect dependencies, and share a read-only snapshot with your team. Edit quarter labels, owners and dates; import or export Markdown and CSV. Your workspace saves in this browser, without an account.

Start with a simple industry example

Each example has four workstreams, four quarters and eight activities. They are illustrative starting points, not verified forecasts or regulatory advice.

Chemistry: Safer coatings: research to marketEnergy: Community solar feasibility to deliveryManufacturing: Predictive maintenance pilotPower Platform: A simple low-code app factory
